Commencing operations as a universal bank on 23 August 2015, it evolved from its origin as non-governmental oraganization (NGO) established in 2001 and a subsequent. The bank's core focus is inclusive banking and serving unbanked and under-banked populations across India.https://bandhan.bank.in/about-us == History == Bandhan was set up in 2001 as a [[not-for-profit]] entity with the objective of financial inclusion and [[women empowerment]]. It started its microfinance operations from Bagnan, a small village, about 60 km from [[Kolkata]]. The model followed for delivery of [[microfinance]] services was individual lending through group formation. Bandhan focused on serving underbanked and underpenetrated markets.{{cite news |title=Bandhan Bank Ltd. |publisher=Business Standard India |url=https://www.business-standard.com/company/bandhan-bank-68090/information/company-history |access-date=6 May 2021}} In 2006, Bandhan acquired a Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC) and created Bandhan Financial Services Private Limited (BFSPL) to scale up its microfinance activities. In 2010, it became the largest microfinance institution (MFI) in the country.{{Cite web |title=Big Lender Of Small Loans |url=https://www.businesstoday.in/magazine/features/story/chandra-shekhar-ghosh-bandhan-bank-md-ceo-loans-251321-2020-03-03 |access-date=2022-04-04 |website=Business Today |date=3 March 2020 |language=en}} In April 2014, Bandhan received an in-principle approval from the [[Reserve Bank of India]] (RBI) for a bank license.{{Cite news |title=RBI grants in-principle approval to IDFC, Bandhan for new bank licences |work=The Economic Times |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/economy/policy/rbi-grants-in-principle-approval-to-idfc-bandhan-for-new-bank-licences/articleshow/33137000.cms?from=mdr |access-date=2022-04-04}} On 17 June 2015, RBI granted the banking licence to Bandhan, making it the first microfinance institution to become a universal bank in India.{{Cite web |date=2 April 2014|title=RBI gives nod to bank licences for IDFC, Bandhan |url=https://www.indiatoday.in/business/story/rbi-accords-bank-licences-to-idfc-bandhan-187337-2014-04-02 |access-date=2022-04-04 |website=India Today |language=en}} Bandhan Bank commenced operations on 23 August 2015. The then [[Minister of Finance (India)|Union Finance Minister]], [[Arun Jaitley]], inaugurated the Bank in [[Kolkata]].{{Cite web |title=Jaitley inaugurates Bandhan Bank in Kolkata |url=https://www.indiablooms.com/finance-details/2781/jaitley-inaugurates-bandhan-bank-in-kolkata.html |access-date=2022-04-04 |website=Indiablooms.com |language=en}} Its public shareholders then included International Finance Corporation; Caladium Investment Pte Ltd (the sovereign wealth fund of [[Singapore]], an arm of GIC); and [[Small Industries Development Bank of India]] (SIDBI). In September 2018, the Reserve Bank of India ([[Reserve Bank of India|RBI]]) barred Bandhan Bank from opening new branches without prior approval and froze the salary of its MD & CEO, Chandra Shekar Ghosh, after the bank failed to reduce its promoter shareholding to the mandated 40% within three years of starting operations.https://www.thehindu.com/business/rbi-cracks-down-on-bandhan-bank-for-violating-norm/article25074274.ece In 2019, Bandhan Bank merged GRUH Finance into its operations, expanding into affordable housing finance and helping lower promoter shareholding to meet RBI ownership regulations.https://bandhan.bank.in/Our-Story == Operations == Bandhan Bank is present in 35 out of 36 states and union territories of India, with nearly 6,400 banking outlets{{Cite web |title=Q4 2025-26 |url=https://bandhan.bank.in/sites/default/files/2026-04/Press-Release-Q4-FY-25-26.pdf}}{{Cite web |title=Bandhan Bank and 5 other stocks that analysts say can offer solid short-term returns - Money-making Ideas |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/news/pi-industries-5-other-stocks-that-analysts-say-can-offer-short-term-returns/money-making-ideas/slideshow/90812468.cms |access-date=2022-04-14 |website=The Economic Times}} After obtaining the universal banking licence from the Reserve Bank of India, Bandhan Bank started operations on 23 August 2015, with 501 branches, 50 [[Automated teller machine|ATMs]] and 2,022 Banking Units (BUs). The Bank has mobilised deposits of ₹1,64,886 crore and its total advances stand at ₹1,55,555 crore as of 30 June 2026. Bandhan Bank is focused on inclusive banking and serves the unbanked and under-banked segments of the country, with 73% of its branches situated in rural and semi-urban areas.{{Cite web |title=Bandhan Bank Investor Presentation Q4 FY2020-21 |url=https://bandhanbank.com/sites/default/files/2021-05/Investor-Presentation-Q4FY20-21.pdf}} == Listing and shareholding == The equity shares of Bandhan Bank are listed on [[Bombay Stock Exchange|BSE]] and the [[National Stock Exchange of India|NSE]].{{cite news |title=Shares of Bandhan Bank get listed |publisher=Motilal Oswal |url=http://www.motilaloswal.com/markets/market-news/news-details/EquityNews/1005515/Shares-of-Bandhan-Bank-get-listed- |access-date=27 March 2018}}{{cite news |title=Bandhan Bank IPO subscribed 14.6 times on last day |publisher=Live Mint |url=https://www.livemint.com/Money/eZEfpFZfmFPUvi9NllTJPJ/Bandhan-Bank-IPO-fully-subscribed-on-last-day.html |access-date=20 March 2018}}{{cite news |title=Bandhan Bank IPO subscribed 14.60 times on final day |publisher=Money Control |url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/ipo/bandhan-bank-ipo-oversubscribed-14-60-times-on-final-day-2531415.html |access-date=19 March 2018}} Bandhan Bank is an associate of Bandhan Financial Holdings Limited (BFHL){{Cite web |date=4 August 2020 |title=Ownership rules: Promoter dilutes 20.95% stake in Bandhan Bank |url=https://www.financialexpress.com/industry/banking-finance/ownership-rules-promoter-dilutes-20-95-stake-in-bandhan-bank/2043843/ |access-date=14 October 2020 |website=The Financial Express |language=en-US}} which holds a 39.99% stake in the bank as on 31 December 2021. Further, BFHL is a wholly owned subsidiary of Bandhan Financial Services Limited (BFSL). Other major shareholders of the Bank as on 31 December 2021, are Housing Development Finance Corporation Limited (9.89%), and Caladium Investment Pte. Limited (7.79%).{{Cite web |title=Bandhan Shareholding - March 31, 2022 |url=https://bandhanbank.com/sites/default/files/2022-04/Shareholding_Pattern_as_on_March312022-for-website.pdf |website=Bandhan Bank}} {| class="wikitable" !
